name: Astrid Christensen
bio:
Astrid's fascination with motorsport ignited during her childhood, spent helping her father, a former rally driver, maintain his car. This hands-on experience fueled her pursuit of a mechanical engineering degree from the Technical University of Denmark. After graduating, she quickly immersed herself in the world of racing, starting as a junior engineer and progressively advancing through the ranks. Her keen eye for detail and ability to identify subtle mechanical advantages allowed her to rapidly climb the motorsport ladder.

Astrid's approach as a technical director centers on fostering a collaborative environment where engineers feel empowered to explore unconventional solutions. She is a firm believer in data-driven decision-making, but she also values the intuition and experience of her team members. She distinguishes herself with a profound understanding of vehicle dynamics combined with a practical understanding of how engineering modifications influence driver performance. Her talent for seeing the big picture while simultaneously obsessing over the smallest detail makes her a highly effective leader.

Known for her innovative solutions, Astrid is driven by a relentless pursuit of improvement and performance enhancement. She is passionate about sustainability in motorsports and is actively seeking ways to integrate eco-friendly technologies into racing strategies.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, wavy, often pulled back into a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Astrid is of medium height with a focused, intense gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical sketches and ideas.
Has a habit of drumming her fingers on the table when deep in thought.
Insists on a specific type of Danish pastry during team meetings.
